name: Dominion
summary: A deck-building card game where players improve their decks to buy Victory cards.
rules_text: Each player starts with 7 Coppers and 3 Estates shuffled as a deck and draws 5 cards. The supply has 3 Treasure piles, Victory piles sized by player count, Curses, and 10 chosen Kingdom piles. On your turn: Action - you may play one Action card, resolving its text which may give extra actions, buys, coins or draws. Buy - play Treasures for coins; you may buy one card from the supply (more if granted), paying its cost and putting it into your discard. Cleanup - discard all played, bought, and in-hand cards to your discard pile, then draw 5 cards, shuffling discard into deck if needed. Turns pass clockwise. Game ends when the Province pile empties or 3 supply piles are empty (4 piles in 4-player), then all players count Victory points in their full decks; most points wins, fewest turns breaks ties.
